subject: 🤖 Nous Hermes Agent Lives in Teams Now, MIT Licensed

stories.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output
stories.quote: Pricing is $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output. You can hit it right now via the Gemini API or AI Studio using model ID
stories.description: Gemini 4 Neon model, between Google's mid-tier and top-tier models

facts.text: Gemini 4 Neon costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
facts.quote: Pricing is $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output.

facts.text: The issue's headline gives the price as $3 per million tokens with a 1M context window.
facts.quote: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon with 1M context at $3 per million tokens

facts.text: Stated as 32% cheaper per task than Gemini 4 Carbon at the default setting; the issue does not say who measured it.
facts.quote: than Gemini 4 Carbon at the default setting

facts.text: Four thinking levels let users trade cost against intelligence per task.
facts.quote: Four thinking levels (low, medium, high, xhigh), letting you dial cost vs. intelligence per task

stories.headline: OpenAI puts GPT-Live-1.1 in the API; standby mode bills idle voice calls at $0.02 per minute instead of $0.05
stories.quote: OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1.1 to API with standby mode cutting idle costs 60%
stories.description: GPT-Live-1.1 voice model, now available in the API

facts.text: In standby mode an open but silent call is billed at $0.02 per minute.
The usual rate is $0.05 per minute; the issue calls this a 60% drop in idle costs.
facts.quote: instead of the usual $0.05. That's a 60% drop in idle costs.

facts.text: The silence timeout is set between 5 and 60 seconds.
facts.quote: Set a silence timeout between 5 and 60 seconds.

facts.text: Standby applies to both GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1.1.
facts.quote: Standby works on both GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1.1

stories.headline: Nous Research releases Hermes Enterprise, its agent for Microsoft Teams and Azure, MIT licensed
stories.quote: Nous Research brings its Hermes agent to Microsoft Teams and Azure
stories.description: Maker of the open-source Hermes AI agent

facts.text: Agent tasks run in isolated Azure Container Apps sandboxes, and it can be deployed in a company's own Azure tenant.
facts.quote: Deploy the whole thing inside your own Azure tenant if your company has strict data rules

facts.text: Hermes Desktop is available from the Microsoft Store for Windows.
facts.quote: Download Hermes Desktop from the Microsoft Store for Windows
